"""Sync mutation status to MUTATIONS_ROADMAP.md for persistent memory."""

import os
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Dict, Any

ROADMAP_FILE = "MUTATIONS_ROADMAP.md"

PILLAR_NAMES = {1: "Self-Evolution", 2: "Resource Optimization", 3: "Model Agnosticism", 4: "Durable State", 5: "Companion Alignment"}
STATUS_ICONS = {"proposed": "Y", "pending_approval": "Y", "approved": "B", "implemented": "G", "promoted": "G", "rejected": "R", "rolled_back": "R", "failed": "R"}

def sync_to_roadmap(mutation: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    mutation_id = mutation.get("mutation_id", "unknown")[:12]
    status = mutation.get("status", "proposed")
    description = mutation.get("description", "No description")[:80]
    pillar = mutation.get("mission_pillar")
    pillar_name = PILLAR_NAMES.get(pillar, "Unknown") if pillar else "Unknown"
    icon = STATUS_ICONS.get(status, "?")
    date = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    agent = mutation.get("agent_name", "unknown")
    entry = f"| {icon} {status} | {mutation_id} | {pillar_name} | {description} | {agent} | {date} |"
    lines = []
    if os.path.exists(ROADMAP_FILE):
        with open(ROADMAP_FILE, "r") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
    header_idx = -1
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.startswith("| Status"):
            header_idx = i
            break
    if header_idx == -1:
        lines = ["# Mutations Roadmap\n", "\n", "Auto-generated by the council.\n", "\n", "| Status | ID | Pillar | Description | Agent | Date |\n", "|--------|-----|--------|-------------|-------|------|\n"]
        header_idx = 4
    existing_idx = -1
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if mutation_id in line:
            existing_idx = i
            break
    if existing_idx >= 0:
        lines[existing_idx] = entry + "\n"
    else:
        insert_at = header_idx + 2
        lines.insert(insert_at, entry + "\n")
    table_lines = [l for l in lines[header_idx+2:] if l.startswith("|")]
    if len(table_lines) > 100:
        lines = lines[:header_idx+2] + table_lines[:100]
    with open(ROADMAP_FILE, "w") as f:
        f.writelines(lines)

"""Telegram /mutate command - operator injects mutations at highest priority."""

from __future__ import annotations

async def handle_mutate_command(text: str, operator_name: str = "human_operator") -> str:
    if not text or not text.strip():
        return "Usage: /mutate <description>"
    description = text.strip()
    try:
        from core.evolution import get_evolution_engine, MutationType
        engine = get_evolution_engine()
        mutation = engine.propose_mutation(
            agent_name=operator_name,
            mutation_type=MutationType.BEHAVIOR_CHANGE,
            description=description,
            rationale=f"Operator priority request: {description}",
            proposed_changes={"operator_request": description, "priority": 100},
            expected_improvement=0.5,
            risk_level="low",
        )
        if mutation.status.value not in ("rejected",):
            engine.approve_mutation(mutation.mutation_id, approved_by=operator_name)
            return f"Approved: {mutation.mutation_id[:12]} - {description}"
        else:
            return f"Rejected: {mutation.rejection_reason}"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"Error: {str(e)[:200]}"
